Thanks for the context, Marissa. 

Plan / timing from Redwood legal:
- NDA (ACME_NDA_v1.pdf): we will prioritize and aim to produce a countersigned version within 3 business days assuming only standard confidentiality edits. If there are extensive commercial changes we may need up to 5 bd.
- DPA: can be reviewed in parallel with the NDA; expect 3–5 business days for our first pass.
- MSA: more involved — estimate 7–10 business days for redline + internal approval cycle.

Routing recommendation: start with NDA (get the parties comfortable) and run DPA review in parallel. MSA sequencing depends on whether ACME requires PoC attachments in the MSA; if not, we can hold MSA while DPA is finalized.

Approval thresholds / redline playbook: 
- We can accept standard mutual confidentiality edits and limited liability caps up to $250k without exec escalation.
- Any changes to data residency, indemnity, or audit rights should be flagged to me and Neha for escalation.

Next steps for the team:
1) Marissa — confirm preferred redline recipient (ACME prefers procurement@acme.com or Samantha).
2) Dev — please attach the short PoC checklist and infra details to the reply to speed procurement.
